title: Big number
description: One very large thin number, most of the slide height, rises from behind a mask until it stands on a gold hairline; an outline copy of the same number slips out behind it, and the unit and one line come in beside it. Plain CSS @keyframes, no library. The number does not count: this block is about size and entrance.

props.value: required, the number as you want it shown, 1-4 characters (a real one)
props.text: one line: what the number is

example.text: From motion graphics on your own video to 3D.
